purpose: Phase 1 real-lineage data pack for the Our LGCY demo. Replaces the fictional sample family on the founder's direct lines only. Every fact carries a status and a source citation. Unknown facts are absent, never inferred; the gap list names what is missing and which record decides it.

status_vocabulary.Connected: A primary record corroborates a link between two records or people.
status_vocabulary.Lead: A candidate with evidence shown and a decider named. Never presented as a connection.
status_vocabulary.Probable: Family-reported or founder-supplied, corroborated short of a primary record, or carried at index strength from a prior gated pass.
